```{r}
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast) 
library(keras)    

# ======================================================================
# 1. ENGINES: THE SWITCHBOARD CORES
# ======================================================================

# --- ENGINE 0: NAIVE PERSISTENCE ---
engine_naive <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  last_val <- tail(train_df$Thermostat_Temperature, 1)
  preds <- rep(last_val, nrow(test_df))
  return(list(preds = as.numeric(preds), imp = NULL))
}

# --- ENGINE A: REGRESSION (LM, RF, GBM) ---
engine_regression <- function(train_df, test_df, algo) {
  # Clean out constant columns for this specific window
  train_x <- train_df %>% 
    select(-DateTime, -Thermostat_Temperature) %>% 
    select(where(~n_distinct(.) > 1))
  
  target <- train_df$Thermostat_Temperature
  
  # Train model
  mod <- train(
    y = target,
    x = train_x,
    method = algo,
    trControl = trainControl(method = "none"),
    preProcess = c("center", "scale")
  )
  
  # Extract Importance for LM only (to explain why it's winning)
  importance_df <- NULL
  if(algo == "lm") {
    importance_df <- varImp(mod)$importance %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
      rename(Importance = Overall) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
  }
  
  preds <- predict(mod, newdata = test_df[, colnames(train_x)])
  return(list(preds = as.numeric(preds), imp = importance_df))
}

# --- ENGINE B: STATISTICAL (ARIMA, SARIMA, SARIMAX) ---
engine_stat_ts <- function(train_df, test_df, algo) {
  y_ts <- ts(train_df$Thermostat_Temperature, frequency = 288)
  
  if (algo == "sarimax") {
    x_train <- as.matrix(train_df %>% select(-DateTime, -Thermostat_Temperature) %>% select(where(~n_distinct(.) > 1)))
    fit <- auto.arima(y_ts, xreg = x_train, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE)
    fcast <- forecast(fit, xreg = as.matrix(test_df[, colnames(x_train)]), h = nrow(test_df))
  } else {
    fit <- auto.arima(y_ts, seasonal = (algo == "sarima"), stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE)
    fcast <- forecast(fit, h = nrow(test_df))
  }
  return(list(preds = as.numeric(fcast$mean), imp = NULL))
}

# --- ENGINE C: DEEP LEARNING (LSTM, RNN) ---
engine_deep_learning <- function(train_df, test_df, algo) {
  prep <- preProcess(train_df %>% select(-DateTime), method = "range")
  train_s <- predict(prep, train_df %>% select(-DateTime))
  test_s  <- predict(prep, test_df %>% select(-DateTime))
  
  x_train <- array(as.matrix(train_s %>% select(-Thermostat_Temperature)), 
                   dim = c(nrow(train_s), 1, ncol(train_s)-1))
  y_train <- as.matrix(train_s$Thermostat_Temperature)
  
  model <- keras_model_sequential()
  if(algo == "lstm") {
    model %>% layer_lstm(units = 16, input_shape = c(1, ncol(train_s)-1))
  } else {
    model %>% layer_simple_rnn(units = 16, input_shape = c(1, ncol(train_s)-1))
  }
  
  model %>% layer_dense(units = 1) %>% compile(loss = 'mae', optimizer = 'adam')
  model %>% fit(x_train, y_train, epochs = 5, batch_size = 256, verbose = 0)
  
  x_test <- array(as.matrix(test_s %>% select(-Thermostat_Temperature)), 
                  dim = c(nrow(test_s), 1, ncol(test_s)-1))
  s_preds <- model %>% predict(x_test)
  
  t_min <- prep$ranges[1, "Thermostat_Temperature"]
  t_max <- prep$ranges[2, "Thermostat_Temperature"]
  final_preds <- s_preds * (t_max - t_min) + t_min
  
  return(list(preds = as.numeric(final_preds), imp = NULL))
}

# ======================================================================
# 2. CONFIGURATION & DATA LOADING
# ======================================================================

data_master <- read_csv("../data/final_preprocessed_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

MODELS <- c("naive", "lm", "rf", "gbm", "arima", "sarima", "sarimax", "lstm", "rnn")
WEEKS  <- c(1, 4, 8) 
N_ITER <- 2 

test_set <- data_master %>% filter(DateTime >= ymd("2017-08-25") & DateTime <= ymd("2017-09-07"))

seasonal_blocks <- list(
  Winter = list(start = ymd("2017-01-01"), end = ymd("2017-03-19")),
  Spring_Summer_Hybrid = list(start = ymd("2017-05-07"), end = ymd("2017-08-04"))
)

# ======================================================================
# 3. RUN AUDITION LOOP
# ======================================================================

results <- data.frame()
lm_importance_list <- list()

for (m in MODELS) {
  cat("\nAuditioning:", toupper(m))
  
  for (period in names(seasonal_blocks)) {
    base_train <- data_master %>% 
      filter(DateTime >= seasonal_blocks[[period]]$start & DateTime <= seasonal_blocks[[period]]$end)
    
    for (wk in WEEKS) {
      row_size <- floor(wk * (7 * 24 * 60 / 5))
      
      for (i in 1:N_ITER) {
        # --- CAPACITY CHECK & SAMPLING ---
        if (nrow(base_train) <= row_size) {
          temp_train <- base_train
        } else {
          start_idx  <- sample(1:(nrow(base_train) - row_size + 1), 1)
          temp_train <- base_train %>% slice(start_idx:(start_idx + row_size - 1))
        }
        
        # --- ROUTING ---
        res <- tryCatch({
          if (m == "naive") engine_naive(temp_train, test_set)
          else if (m %in% c("lm", "rf", "gbm")) engine_regression(temp_train, test_set, m)
          else if (m %in% c("arima", "sarima", "sarimax")) engine_stat_ts(temp_train, test_set, m)
          else engine_deep_learning(temp_train, test_set, m)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat(paste0("\n Error in ", m, ": ", e$message))
          return(NULL)
        })
        
        if(!is.null(res)) {
          rmse <- sqrt(mean((res$preds - test_set$Thermostat_Temperature)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
          results <- bind_rows(results, data.frame(
            Model = m, Season = period, Weeks = wk, Iteration = i, RMSE = rmse
          ))
          
          # Capture LM importance if available
          if(m == "lm" && !is.null(res$imp)) {
            lm_importance_list[[paste(period, wk, i, sep="_")]] <- res$imp
          }
        }
      }
    }
    cat(".") 
  }
}

# ======================================================================
# 4. FINAL ANALYSIS & SKILL SCORES
# ======================================================================

# 4.1 Performance Ranking
naive_rmse <- mean(results$RMSE[results$Model == "naive"], na.rm = TRUE)

summary_table <- results %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    SD_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
    Skill_Score = round((1 - (Avg_RMSE / naive_rmse)) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Skill_Score))

cat("\n\n--- FINAL AUDITION SUMMARY ---\n")
print(summary_table)

# 4.2 Feature Importance (The "Why")
if(length(lm_importance_list) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- TOP LINEAR DRIVERS ---\n")
  final_imp <- bind_rows(lm_importance_list) %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(Avg_Importance = mean(Importance)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Avg_Importance))
  print(head(final_imp, 10))
}

# 4.3 Visualization
ggplot(results, aes(x = reorder(Model, -RMSE), y = RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Model Audition: RMSE Comparison",
       subtitle = "Comparing Baseline vs Regression vs Statistical vs Deep Learning")
```
